# Data Science Minor: Course Guide 2026

Minato University, Academic Affairs Office

## 1 About the minor

Students of any faculty can take the Data Science Minor. You complete the minor when you pass every course in the table below.

| Course | Credits |
| --- | --- |
| Foundations of Statistics | 2 |
| Introduction to Data Analysis | 2 |
| Programming Lab | 4 |
| Machine Learning Concepts | 4 |
| Data Science Project | 4 |
| Total | 16 |

## 2 Order of courses

Take Introduction to Data Analysis only after you pass Foundations of Statistics.

Take Machine Learning Concepts only after you pass Introduction to Data Analysis and Programming Lab.

First-year students should start with Foundations of Statistics in the autumn term.

## 3 Registration

Register for the minor in the student system from Monday, April 6, 2026 to Friday, April 17, 2026.
